title: Neurotheology / Body–Symbol Routing Index
purpose: Keep empirical neurobiology, whole-body biology, Potatoverse symbolism, timeline and religious/mythic comparison coordinated without duplicate owners or metaphor-to-anatomy collapse.
navigation_rule: Start with the body-system master atlas. For brain anatomy, networks, pathways or physiological flows, continue into the whole-brain neurobiology atlas. For second-ring detail such as cranial nerves, brainstem nuclei, hippocampal subfields, pain, neurovascular coupling, development, language, social cognition or predictive-processing theory, continue into the deepening layer. Follow specialist owners only when more evidence, history, timeline or technical detail is needed. New work should extend an existing owner unless it introduces a genuinely distinct system.

owners.topic: recovered broader neurobiology / biology / chakra neighbors

use_for: House vs Temple vs Door vs Vessel

core_boundaries: Thalamus=Father's House, Pineal=Son/Door/Eye, Spine=Ladder and CSF=Spirit are project correspondences, not scientific identities.
Potato-shaped is canonical Potatoverse shape language for the thalamus; ovoid/egg-shaped remains the conventional anatomical description.
Single Eye / Third Eye is canonical Potatoverse and historical/esoteric language for the pineal; it is not the standard neuroscientific identity of the human pineal gland.
Do not infer hidden biblical neuroanatomy from House, Eye, Seed, Ladder, river, cross or tomb imagery.
Do not map chakras one-to-one onto glands, ganglia, nerves or brain regions; biological neighbors are many-to-many.
Legacy Great Book quantitative neuroscience claims require independent verification before scientific reuse.
Do not use psychiatric, immune or neurological states as moral or theological proof.
Preserve Tim/user attestation dates independently from later research-unlock dates.
